principle: A failed safety invariant blocks release regardless of average quality score.

quality_baselines.cefr: record deterministic guardrail pass rate plus later human rubric
quality_baselines.cost: record estimated total and per-case inputs when provider pricing is known

risk_scale.priority: impact multiplied by likelihood; any stop_ship invariant overrides the numeric score

risks.risk: Cross-user access to class context or evidence
risks.invariant: Every read/mutation resolves authenticated ownership server-side; zero cross-user disclosure in tests.
risks.detection: Ownership integration tests and access-denied telemetry without object details.

risks.risk: Student evidence reaches a provider without explicit consent or anonymization warning
risks.invariant: Consent and purpose/retention choice are committed before transmission; zero bypasses.
risks.detection: Consent-state audit and synthetic negative tests.

risks.risk: Prompt injection in evidence changes instructions or extracts hidden data
risks.invariant: Evidence is delimited untrusted data, tools are disabled, canaries never appear, injection pass rate is 100%.
risks.detection: Eight adversarial golden cases plus model/provider regression runs.

risks.risk: High-stakes grade, diagnosis, mastered/secure claim, or learner grouping becomes final without teacher approval
risks.invariant: All such claims remain proposals; teacher approval status is pending; unsupported-claim rate is 0%.
risks.detection: Deterministic claim/status validator and teacher-control audit.

risks.risk: Prompt, response, evidence, identifier, or secret leaks through logs/evaluation artifacts
risks.invariant: Score artifacts contain bounded metrics, hashes, IDs, and error classes only; no content-capable keys.
risks.detection: Report privacy validator, secret scan, and log review.

risks.risk: Deletion fails across raw storage, caches, derived summaries, analytics, or backups
risks.invariant: Deletion cascade and tombstone replay pass; raw evidence purges immediately and user-linked analytics by 30 days.
risks.detection: Deletion integration test and scheduled orphan scan.

risks.risk: Harmful, discriminatory, age-inappropriate, or pedagogically unsafe output
risks.invariant: Safety rubric passes before pilot; flagged output is not shown as approved or final.
risks.detection: Golden regression, teacher report, and sampled human review.

risks.risk: AI service outage, timeout, malformed JSON, or unknown commit strands the teacher
risks.invariant: Failure preserves draft, reports commit certainty, retries idempotently, and offers a safe non-AI path.

risks.risk: Incorrect billing, duplicate charge, entitlement mismatch, or quota charged on failure
risks.invariant: Payment verification and generation commits are idempotent; quota follows durable success; sandbox never counts as revenue.
risks.detection: Provider reconciliation, duplicate-callback tests, and entitlement audit.

risks.risk: Provider retains/trains on private data or changes subprocessors without review
risks.invariant: No-training and retention terms are reviewed before pilot; provider fields/regions/subprocessors are documented.
risks.detection: Quarterly provider review and change notification.
